text:
Mira: Quick heads-up — after the kernel-selector tweak merged yesterday I'm seeing ~12-18% slower tail latency on FP8 for 8k seq runs with LLaMA-2-70B in the perf harness. Repro locally and in canary.

Jon: ugh. Can you paste the perf harness command and logs?

Mira: repro command: ```./bench/run_infer.sh --model llama2-70b --seq 8192 --batch 1 --quant fp8 --kernels auto``` log snippet: "avg p99=245ms -> 285ms" and CPU spikes from memcopy at KV evict path.

Sam K: thanks. I ran a profiler (cpu+gpu timeline) — looks like kernel selector picked a new FP8 GEMM that has worse launch overhead for long sequences. Kernel time per token slightly lower but overall stalls due to extra kv-cache memcpy and a fallback path for attention mask packing.

Lee: can you drop selector debug output? We have flags: --selector-debug and --trace-kernel. Also want to see batching heuristics decisions (why batch size remained 1).

Mira: selector trace attached in thread (excerpt):
```
[selector] model=llama2-70b seq=8192 policy=latency
ranked_candidates=[fp8_gemm_v2 (est 0.9x), int8_gemm (est 1.05x), fp16_ref (est 1.2x)]
chosen=fp8_gemm_v2
notes=fp8_gemm_v2 has high kernel launch overhead for >4k seq
```

Sam K: that explains it. The estimator is token-avg based; it underweights long-ttl memcpy cost (KV cache writes scale with seq length). We need calibration that includes KV-copy cost per token for long sequences.

Jon: proposal: expose two SDK knobs: "quant_mode" (auto|prefer_fp8|prefer_int8|force_fp16) and "calibration_profile" (short_seq|long_seq|mixed). Default stays auto. Add safety rail: if calibration_profile=long_seq, force selector to add memcpy penalty to fp8 candidates and prefer int8/fp16.

Lee: +1. Also add a runtime flag to temporarily pin kernel: "kernel_hint": "fp8_gemm_v1" for debugging rollouts. Avoids full deploy.

Mira: for docs we should list presets and their intended workloads, e.g.:
- short_seq: chat, seq<=2048, enables aggressive fp8 optimizations
- long_seq: retrieval/long context, seq>4096, prefer kernels with low launch overhead and avoid tiny-batch optimized fp8 kernels
- mixed: heuristics based on rolling seq distribution (default)

Sam K: implementation note — calibration needs two phases: microbench per kernel (latency & launch) and end-to-end sample workload run to measure KV-copy scaling. We should cache profiles per model+hw ABI+quantization and invalidate on kernel changes.

CalibBot: FYI — new calibration runs queued for llama2-70b on p4d yesterday; will post results when finished.

Mira: perf-bot canary results show canary region latency bump by 10% in 3/5 incidents; I'm going to pin canary to fp16 fallback until we have the codec penalties added.

perf-bot: Canary pinned to fp16_ref for llama2-70b in eu-west-1 by @Mira. Rollforward blocked until selector fix.

Jon: action items: Sam + Lee to add memcpy penalty model into selector heuristics; Sam to add SDK knobs (quant_mode, calibration_profile, kernel_hint); Mira to update docs draft for presets & safety rails; CalibBot + perf-bot to rerun and report.

Sam K: I'll open a PR for selector heuristics with tests that simulate varying KV sizes. Will include a small opt-in SDK param names and default behavior.

Mira: thanks — if anyone sees regressions please @Mira and add perf traces to the PR. :thumbsup:
